lines.zh: 我挂在叶下，只随着风摆。
lines.en: I hang under the leaf, swinging only with the wind.
I cannot move; I can only wait.
When the wind comes, I sway twice.
I hang from a fine thread.
When the leaf turns, I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢被吹向枝的另一侧。
lines.en: I am blown slowly to the other side of the twig.
I do not walk; the leaf is moving.

lines.zh: 我悬在那儿，整夜都这样。
lines.en: I hang there like that all night.
I sway along with the branch.
A raindrop knocks me aside.
I swing back slowly to where I was.
There is nothing I can do.
I am waiting for a certain time.
I hang firmly and will not fall.
I grow heavier by the day.

lines.zh: 我静静地挂着，壳里在动。
lines.en: I hang still, and inside the shell something moves.
Sunlight shows through my shell.

lines.zh: 我的外形已经不太像虫了。
lines.en: My shape is no longer much like a grub.
I hear the wind outside.
I hold perfectly still.
My shell hardens day by day.
Something inside is pressing.
I wait for that one moment.
Other insects crawl over the leaf.
My color has faded a little.

lines.zh: 我吊在同一个位置，很久了。
lines.en: I have hung in the same spot a long while.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，只能感到影子。
lines.en: I cannot see you, only feel your shadow.
Your shadow covers the light.
I hang beneath the leaf, hidden.
When you reach out, I start to sway.
I watch you from inside the shell.
Do not touch me; I will fall.
I sense your warmth.
I draw the shell in a little.
I swing for a long while before stopping.
It hurts, and I cannot cry out.
Something inside has been disturbed.
I draw myself tighter.
The thread held and I am still in place.
I steady myself little by little.
It is scored on my inner shell.

lines.zh: 外壳被压出凹陷，我忍着。
lines.en: A dent in my shell; I endure it.
My mouthparts aren't formed yet.

lines.zh: 你把叶子举起来，我没有反应。
lines.en: You hold up a leaf and I do not respond.
My mouth is still forming.
You are holding it too close.

lines.zh: 我只是一动不动地挂着。
lines.en: I only hang there, motionless.
There is no way for me to eat.
You shake the leaf and I sway.

lines.zh: 等你下次来，我就不一样了。
lines.en: Next time you come, I will be different.

lines.zh: 我被碰得一晃，吊丝绷紧了。
lines.en: A knock sets me swinging and the thread pulls taut.
I hit the leaf and bounce off.
I nearly fall from the thread.
I have no legs to brace with.
Your fingertip tips my shell.
I swing slowly back.

lines.zh: 吊丝绷紧，我慢慢摆回来。
lines.en: My silk thread tautens; I swing slowly back.
Do not push me.
I hang where I was, unbroken.
You were lucky this time.
In this state, I do not speak of such things.
That waits until after I emerge.
I hang under the leaf and do not move.

lines.zh: 等我变成别的样子再说。
lines.en: Wait until I am something else.
This shell shuts everything out.
I have no need to be near anyone.
My time has not come.
Let me just hang here.
I have no hands.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在我旁边，我也用不上。
lines.en: You set it beside me and I cannot use it.
The shell encloses everything.

lines.zh: 有东西碰到我，我晃了一下。
lines.en: Something touched me and I swayed.
These are of no use to me.
It slid down past me.
I cannot even turn my head.
Keep it for yourself.
Something touched the leaf.
I feel the shaking and tighten.
There is nothing I can do.
A shadow falls and I draw in.

lines.zh: 这层壳是我唯一的防线。
lines.en: This shell is my only defense.
I draw myself tighter.
I hear it coming near.

lines.zh: 我不动，它也许就看不见我。
lines.en: If I stay still, perhaps it will not see me.
I hold everything still.
I watch it from inside the shell.
It has not gone.
I draw myself in tighter.
It touched the leaf stem.
I can only wait.
I feel its warmth.
I press to the leaf vein and dare not stir.
I hold my shell against the leaf's back.
It has stopped.

lines.zh: 我挣了一下，没别的办法。
lines.en: I struggle once; there is no other way.
I can only sway.
I bump its hand, barely.

lines.zh: 这层壳硬，可也伤不了人。
lines.en: This shell is hard, but it harms no one.
I strain once and the thread pulls taut.
I accomplished nothing.

lines.zh: 壳撞到你，是我唯一的还手。
lines.en: Knocking my shell into you is my only retort.

lines.zh: 我在壳里踢了一下，吓退你。
lines.en: I kick from inside the shell to drive you off.

lines.zh: 我在叶面上结成了这个形状。
lines.en: I formed into this shape on the leaf.
I hang from a fine thread.

lines.zh: 这里的光透过叶子照到我这。
lines.en: Light comes through the leaf to me.
A wind passes outside.
I do not know what I will become.
I hang securely.
The shell hardens slowly.
It is quiet around me.
I seal myself in.

lines.zh: 我掉在土上，壳被磕了一下。
lines.en: I land on the soil and my shell takes a knock.
Water wraps me and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从丝上扯下来。
lines.en: The blast tears me from the thread.

lines.zh: 一股冷意透进壳里，我僵了。
lines.en: Cold seeps into the shell and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 我太久没有变化，壳在发干。
lines.en: I have gone too long unchanged and the shell dries.

lines.zh: 我脱离了丝，一路往下落。
lines.en: I come off the thread and fall away.
